name: yao_open_prompts
description: A practical bilingual AI prompt library designed to support prompt engineering for tasks involving work, learning, content creation, marketing, and everyday applications.

inputs.name: task_description
inputs.description: Description of the task or scenario for which a prompt is needed.

inputs.name: language_preference
inputs.description: Preferred language for the prompt output (e.g., English or Chinese).

inputs.name: context_data
inputs.description: Additional context or information to customize the prompt for specific needs.

outputs.name: ai_prompt
outputs.description: Generated bilingual AI prompt tailored for the specified task and context.

steps: Identify the user's task or scenario requiring an AI prompt.
Select or adapt a bilingual prompt template relevant to the task domain.
Insert contextual information and language preference into the prompt template placeholders.
Generate the customized AI prompt formatted for bilingual usage.
Deliver the prompt for application in AI models or workflows.
use_cases: Creating effective AI prompts for bilingual marketing campaigns.
Generating educational prompts in both English and Chinese for learning applications.
Assisting content creators to produce bilingual text prompts for writing or ideation.
Facilitating daily work-related AI prompt engineering across languages.
patterns: Domain-specific prompt templates for work, learning, marketing, and content creation

prompt_templates.name: marketing_campaign_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create a bilingual marketing message in {language_preference} that highlights {context_data}.

prompt_templates.name: educational_content_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a bilingual educational explanation about {context_data} suitable for learners.

prompt_templates.name: content_creation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Write a bilingual creative text involving {context_data} for content generation.

prompt_templates.name: work_task_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Formulate a bilingual prompt to assist with {context_data} in a professional setting.
